transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I need to address our upcoming production schedule. As we know, Line 4 is scheduled for its planned servo overhaul before the next production cycle, and we have a customer shipment due Monday morning. The good news is that Line 3 can produce the same product while Line 4 is unavailable. Before I can publish the schedule, I need to get sign-off from both maintenance and production. Can we discuss the timeline and make sure we're aligned on this?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share some important details from my contractor assessment, which I completed this afternoon but haven't finalized in the work order yet. The servo overhaul on Line 4 must start Sunday at 06:00, it requires exactly 14 hours of downtime, and it includes replacement of the servo encoder. That means Line 4 would be back online by 20:00 Sunday evening, which should give us time to verify everything before the Monday morning shipment.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something important I found when I reconciled the dispatch board this morning. I haven't frozen the central production plan yet, but the Monday shipment requires exactly 1,000 units, and Line 3 can make at most 400 of those units during Line 4's outage. So even if Line 4 comes back online Sunday evening as Raj described, we need to figure out how to cover the remaining 600 units.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for those critical details. Let me summarize what we're working with: Raj, the servo overhaul on Line 4 must start Sunday at 06:00, takes exactly 14 hours, and includes replacing the servo encoder — so Line 4 is back by 20:00 Sunday. Marta, the Monday shipment needs exactly 1,000 units, and Line 3 can only produce 400 during the outage, leaving a 600-unit gap. So the key question is: can we pre-build the remaining 600 units on Line 4 before Sunday at 06:00? If Line 4 runs through Saturday and we stock enough output ahead of the overhaul, we'd cover the gap. Raj, is there any constraint on Line 4 running right up until 06:00 Sunday? And Marta, does the plan allow for pre-building inventory on Line 4 before the outage starts? I need both of your sign-offs before I can publish this schedule.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, from a maintenance perspective, there's no constraint preventing Line 4 from running right up until 06:00 Sunday. My contractor assessment specifies that the overhaul must start at 06:00 Sunday, but it doesn't impose any requirement to take Line 4 offline earlier than that. So as long as production wraps up and the line is cleared and ready for the contractors by 06:00 sharp, we're good. I can confirm maintenance sign-off on that basis, provided Marta confirms the pre-build plan covers the 600-unit gap.
